_comment: A job file of the Training (Training.run): the lane head of E273 as a diagnostic (no_card = feeds no verdict). `run_args` is needed because the Training adds --split train and this project's splits are val / test / confirm. A run that feeds a verdict: replace no_card by card {hyp, pred, rule} or list the arm's run id in the run_ids of its card BEFORE the start. Start: from autoresearch/, `AR_PROJECT=../bev_fusion_lane_center python3 -m Training Training.run ../bev_fusion_lane_center/training/configs/jobs/e273_head_example.json --project ../bev_fusion_lane_center`.
note: smoke of the E273 head through the Training class (a few steps per phase)
